title: Yippie Hoarding Bug for Lethal Company Mobs
description: Replaces the sounds of the Hoarding Bug from Lethal Company Mobs to YIPPIE
body:
Have any suggestion? Want to report a bug? We have a Discord server! You can join and ask anything you want!

Introduction

This is a really simple resourcepack that replaces the sounds of the Hoarding Bug added by the mod Lethal Company Mobs to YIPPIE.

 

This resourcepack came into existance by popular demand of the community!

 

To make this resourcepack work, you obviously need to have the mod Lethal Company Mobs installed.

 

Click here to get Lethal Company Mobs.
